maddeler.e:
افتكرن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَكَرْنَ (iftakarna) /if.ta.kar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
# اُفْتُكِرْنَ (uftukirna) /uf.tu.kir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
# اِفْتَكِرْنَ (iftakirna) /if.ta.kir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
